tagline: See, run and control every Magento cron job from the admin, and get warned when cron stops or a job keeps failing.
key_features: Grid of every cron job with run statistics
Run Now in the background, recorded in the schedule
Enable, disable and reschedule jobs without code
Timeline of the last 1 to 24 hours

benefits.title: Know cron is running
benefits.text: A status panel and admin messages tell you when cron has stopped, a job keeps failing or a job is stuck.

benefits.title: Act without SSH
benefits.text: Run a job now, switch a noisy job off or move it to a quieter time from the admin, with the change applied to Magento's own cron.

benefits.title: Safe to hand over
benefits.text: Separate permissions for viewing, running, changing and cleaning up, and every manual run is recorded with who started it.

showcase.label: Cron Jobs
showcase.title: Every job on one grid
showcase.text: Group, schedule, state, last run, last status, average duration and recent errors for every job, with filters, keyword search and row actions.

showcase.label: Job page
showcase.title: Change a schedule with a preview
showcase.text: Enable or disable a job, enter a cron expression or pick a preset, and see the next runs in the store timezone before you save.

showcase.label: Timeline
showcase.title: See what ran and when
showcase.text: A chart per job for the last 1 to 24 hours, coloured by status, with details on hover or keyboard focus and a filter for jobs with problems.

showcase.label: Clean-up
showcase.title: Tidy the queue in a few clicks
showcase.text: Remove pending or missed entries, mark stuck jobs as failed and delete old history, for all jobs or one job, each after a confirmation.

showcase.label: Settings
showcase.title: Warnings tuned to your store
showcase.text: Set when to warn, how long a job may run, which jobs to ignore and who receives failure e-mails. Every field shows its default.

feature_groups.title: Jobs
items: All jobs from crontab.xml and config-based schedules
Run Now for one job or up to 20 at once
Enable, disable and reschedule, singly or in bulk
Restore the default schedule at any time
Changes stored in the configuration, exportable with app:config:dump

feature_groups.title: Schedule and timeline
items: cron_schedule as a grid with keyword search and filters
Remove queued entries, mark stuck jobs, clean history

feature_groups.title: Health
items: Status panel on the Cron Jobs and Schedule pages
Admin message when cron has not run for N minutes
Admin message when a job fails N times in a row or runs too long
Stuck jobs marked as failed automatically
Failure e-mails with a minimum interval

feature_groups.title: Admin and developers
items: CLI: list, run, status and set
Manual runs logged with trigger and admin user
Admin only, nothing added to the storefront
